cards.title: stem cell therapy
cards.text: Stem cells have the ability to self-renew and also have the ability to differentiate into various types of cells such as blood vessels, cardiac muscle, bone, and fat.

cards.title: PRP
cards.text: By processing blood and injecting PRP into the affected area, the self-repairing ability of tissues is enhanced. By activating the production of collagen and elastin, you can expect various beauty effects.

cards.title: exosome
cards.text: Refers to vesicles secreted outside cells, and their particularly important role is in the transmission of information between cells. These exosomes have a bag-like structure and contain important information related to genes, such as nucleic acids (microRNA and messenger RNA) and proteins.

menuCards.title: Norris Clinic Medical Menu in Tennoji/Namba, Osaka City
menuCards.text: At Norris Clinic, a cosmetic dermatology clinic in Osaka, we offer a wide range of treatments to help our many patients achieve beauty and smiles.

cards.title: HARG therapy
cards.text: It is a regenerative medicine that improves thinning hair and promotes hair regeneration and growth by injecting the ``HARG cocktail'' containing more than 150 types of growth factors extracted from adipose stem cells into the scalp.

cards.title: laser treatment
cards.sub: Problems with stains and acne, improvement of skin quality
cards.text: By irradiating with Pico Laser (PicoWay), which has 3 different wavelengths, you can expect total skin beautification effects, including improving age spots and acne, and improving skin quality.

cards.title: medical hair removal
cards.sub: Feel the effects in a short period of time
cards.text: We have introduced the ``Light Shere Duet,'' which is equipped with a large irradiation port and suction/cooling system.

At Norris Clinic, we have a full range of equipment to ensure the satisfaction of our patients.
We will support you to get rid of your concerns and complexes.

items.name: light shear duet
items.text: Heat-destructive diode laser hair removal equipment. Two types of handpieces are used.

items.name: Luminous IPL M22
items.text: Luminous photofacial equipment. We will select and irradiate the light that is most suitable for each person's concerns from 7 types of light. Effective for age spots, freckles, melasma, acne scars, red face, beautiful skin, etc.

items.name: Ultracell Q+ (HIFU)
items.text: By using three cartridges, it is possible to approach the three deep layers that normal lasers cannot reach, and lift the skin from the inside. Effective for tightening, removing sagging, and lifting the skin.

items.name: PicoWay
items.text: Skin laser manufactured by Syneron Candela. The short irradiation time allows the treatment to be performed with minimal damage to the skin. Effective for stains, freckles, acne scars, wrinkles, pigmentation, etc.

items.name: re-Beau 2
items.text: We perform skin diagnosis by visualizing skin conditions, hidden spots, and redness that are difficult to see with the naked eye. After diagnosis, we will recommend treatment and care methods tailored to each individual.

items.name: derma pen 4
items.text: Microscopic needles are used to make holes in the skin and utilize the natural healing power to make the skin more beautiful. The world's fastest vibration frequency per second allows for treatment with minimal downtime. Effective for tightening acne scars and pores.

textSection.title: Norris Clinic's unique commitment and reasons why people choose us

blocks.text: At Norris Clinic, we offer a wide range of treatment options centered on advanced beauty regenerative medicine in order to help our many patients achieve beauty and smiles.

items.title: water light injection
items.text: Recommended for those who are concerned about dry skin and those who want to restore the moisture and firmness of their skin. A skin beautifying treatment born in Korea, the beauty powerhouse. A beauty ingredient whose main ingredient is non-crosslinked hyaluronic acid, which has high moisturizing properties, is finely injected into the dermis and epidermis. This can moisturize and firm your skin. At Norris Clinic, we also offer "PRP water light injection" which is a form of PRP treatment. By injecting Platelet Rich Plasma (PRP) extracted from your own blood, you can solve all your skin problems.

items.title: aging care treatment
items.text: Recommended for those who are worried about aging, such as dark circles and hollows around the eyes. Norris Clinic's anti-aging treatment is unique in that in addition to facial care, it also provides total body care. We will guide you to the most suitable treatment menu according to your concerns.
